Job Overview: We are seeking a highly motivated and organized Appointment Setter to join our sales team. The ideal candidate should have excellent communication skills, be able to work in a fast-paced environment, and have a positive attitude. text:
Hi, I’m Mina Castellan, and I’d be glad to support your marketing agency as an Appointment Setter.

I have 5 years of experience working with data analysis, Excel, SQL, Power BI, Google Sheets, dashboard building, data cleaning, and data visualization. While my background is more data-focused, I’m highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with structured processes, tracking activity accurately, and keeping communication moving efficiently, which are all important in appointment setting.

In a fast-paced sales environment, I understand the importance of clear communication, consistent follow-up, and careful record keeping. I’m confident working with CRM-style workflows, managing multiple tasks at once, and staying on top of outreach activities so appointments are scheduled smoothly for the sales team. I also value professionalism and persistence when engaging leads through direct messages and phone calls.

One relevant project I can share is the Sales KPI dashboard for Marlowe Furniture, where I built one Power BI report on a star-schema model to replace 14 separate Excel sales reports. That work consolidated 14 reports into 1 and reduced monthly close reporting from 3 days to 4 hours. This project reflects how I handle organized workflows, accuracy, and efficient reporting under time-sensitive conditions.

I’d bring the same attention to detail and process mindset to this role by helping track lead interactions, following up consistently, and supporting the sales team with accurate appointment scheduling. I’m comfortable working with structured information, and I’m quick to learn new systems and communication workflows when needed.

If you’re looking for someone dependable, organized, and proactive, I’d love the chance to contribute to your team and help create more booked appointments for your sales team.
